name: Creeping Ectoplasm (CR 2)
body:
Creeping Ectoplasm
CR 2

A minor haunt devoid of any shred of individuality or history, manifesting as a shapeless blob of ectoplasm.

XP 600; N haunt (10-ft. radius); Caster Level 2nd; Notice Perception DC 16 (to smell a sweet scent); hp 4; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, a mass of ectoplasm appears out of nowhere, covering the area with a blanket of luminescent green goo that acts like a grease spell (DC 11).

DESTRUCTION

The area where it manifests must be consecrated or hallowed, even temporarily.
